name: svaraprana
description: SvaraPrana (स्वरप्राण) - Zero-Hardware Ambient Acoustic Care Bridge & Non-Invasive Healthcare Coordination for 140M+ Indian Elders. SaarthiX Hackathon 2026.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('public')) fs.mkdirSync('public'); fs.copyFileSync('index.html','public/index.html'); if(fs.existsSync('assets')) fs.cpSync('assets','public/assets',{recursive:true}); if(fs.existsSync('manifest.json')) fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json','public/manifest.json'); if(fs.existsSync('favicon.png')) fs.copyFileSync('favicon.png','public/favicon.png'); console.log('Build complete: synchronized index.html and assets to public/');"

author: Harish Hari (Principal Software Engineer & Technical Designer)
